summary: A short natural-language delivery cue rather than a long prose voice description.

reference.label: Reference delivery tags
reference.instructions: Fish S2 Pro accepts short natural-language delivery cues rendered as bracket tags by the service. Suggest at most two compatible cues; prefer one combined dominant cue. Preserve requested restraint. Do not invent speaker, accent or pause tokens, sound effects, laughter, events or words to speak. The reference supplies identity and accent; tags do not guarantee either.
